author: KEXP
description: Under the musical project La Texana, Tijuana-born artist José Ramírez finds inspiration in post-punk and Spanish alternative rock. Our latest in-studio session with host Albina Cabrera invites La Texana to share a performance of "Un día como hoy" and more Live on KEXP.
title: La Texana performs "Un día como hoy" & more Live on KEXP

author: KEXP
description:
http://KEXP.ORG presents La Texana performing live in the KEXP studio. Recorded August 11,, 2026.

Songs:
Terco 00:56
La Parca 03:16
Resiste 06:16
Siempre me cuesta regresar 10:00
